end.text: 11 months on your shelf. Allah's words, unopened.
end.gold: This morning: one page. Before you open your phone.

captions: Sunday, 9:20. The city library. Three hours of notes.
Next to you, an old man. A small Quran, its cover worn soft.
Your phone lights up. 214 notifications. You read them all.
He closes his Quran, kisses it, and smiles at you.
And you remember yours. Top shelf. Your name on the first page.
Home. The shelf. A thin line of dust on green leather.
You wipe it with your sleeve. Your name, in your mother's handwriting.
One page. Your voice shakes. Then it doesn't.

post.caption:
11 months on your shelf. Allah's words, unopened. 📖

An old man in the library read every line with his finger. Yours still has your name on the first page — and a thin line of dust.

“Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured.” (13:28)

This morning: one page. Before you open your phone.
